definitions.explanation: To crush or grind something into smaller pieces or powder using a mill, grinder, or similar tool. Most commonly used for coffee beans, pepper, and meat.

examples.japanese: コーヒー{豆|まめ}を{挽|ひ}く。
{挽|ひ}きたてのコーヒーは{香|かお}りがいい。
examples.english: Freshly ground coffee has a great aroma.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}を{挽|ひ}いてハンバーグを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I ground the meat and made hamburger patties.

notes:
{挽|ひ}く specifically means to grind food items. It shares the reading ひく with {引|ひ}く (to pull) and {弾|ひ}く (to play an instrument), but these are different words with different kanji.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コーヒーを{挽|ひ}く: to grind coffee
- {豆|まめ}を{挽|ひ}く: to grind beans
- {肉|にく}を{挽|ひ}く: to mince meat
- コショウを{挽|ひ}く: to grind pepper
- {挽|ひ}き{肉|にく}: ground meat, minced meat
- {挽|ひ}きたて: freshly ground
- {粗挽|あらび}き: coarsely ground

NOTE: The compound {挽|ひ}き{肉|にく} (ground meat) is one of the most common words using this kanji. It appears on supermarket labels throughout Japan.
